demo.notice: Fictional demo data. Raju, Manoj, Sarita and Iqbal are invented, and so are the photographs, the voices and every memory named in this pack. Real patient content must always come from a caregiver-provided pack.

missions.title: A glass of water
missions.description: Walk through to the kitchen, find the water jug, then answer one question about the family.

steps.instruction: Raju, would you walk through to the kitchen?

hints.repeat: Raju, would you walk through to the kitchen?
hints.guide: The kitchen is this way. Go through here.

steps.instruction: The water jug should be in here. Can you spot it?

hints.repeat: The water jug should be in here. Can you spot it?
hints.guide: There it is, on the counter.

steps.question: Who took you out on the boat at Chilika every winter?

hints.repeat: Who took you out on the boat at Chilika every winter?
hints.guide: It was Iqbal, your old friend from the village.

missions.title: Morning walk
missions.description: A walk around the house: the radio in the living room, the water jug in the kitchen, then back to the framed photograph.

steps.instruction: Let us begin in the living room, Raju. Please walk through.

hints.repeat: Let us begin in the living room, Raju. Please walk through.
hints.guide: The living room is this way.

steps.instruction: Your radio is in here somewhere. Can you find it?

hints.repeat: Your radio is in here somewhere. Can you find it?
hints.guide: There it is, on the low unit by the window.

steps.instruction: Now would you walk through to the kitchen?

hints.repeat: Now would you walk through to the kitchen?

steps.instruction: Can you spot the water jug in here?

hints.repeat: Can you spot the water jug in here?
hints.guide: There it is, on the counter.

steps.instruction: Now let us walk back through to the living room.

hints.repeat: Now let us walk back through to the living room.
hints.guide: The living room is back this way.

steps.instruction: Can you find the photograph in the frame on the wall?

hints.repeat: Can you find the photograph in the frame on the wall?
